question.problem:
Find the coordinates of the vector $x$ relative to the basis $B={{b}_{1},{b}_{2},{b}_{3}},$ where

$$
{b}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 2 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,x=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{aligned}].
$$

If $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}]$ then what is the value of ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}?$
question.worked_solution:
We need to find ${x}_{1}$,  ${x}_{2}$, and ${x}_{3}$ such that 

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}{b}_{1}+{x}_{2}{b}_{2}+{x}_{3}{b}_{3} & =x \\ {x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1 \\ 1\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 2 \\ 1\end{aligned}]+{x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

From this, we get the system with the augmented matrix $M$, which we reduce using Gaussian elimination:

$$
\begin{aligned}M= & [\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 2 & 2 \\ 1 & 2 & 1 & 3 \\ 1 & 1 & 0 & -1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-1){R}_{1} \\ ∼ & [\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 2 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & -1 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 0 & -1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-1){R}_{1} \\ ∼ & [\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 2 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & -1 & 1 \\ 0 & -1 & -2 & -3\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & ↔{R}_{3} \\ ∼ & [\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 2 & 2 \\ 0 & -1 & -2 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & -1 & 1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now 

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}+2{x}_{3}=2 \\ -{x}_{2}-2{x}_{3}=-3 \\ -{x}_{3}=1.\end{aligned}
$$

From third equation we get ${x}_{3}=-1$ and substituting this value into the second equation yields ${x}_{2}=-2(-1)+3=5.$ Finally, substituting ${x}_{2}=5$ and ${x}_{3}=-1$ into the first equation, we obtain

$$
{x}_{1}+2(5)+2(-1)=2\,⟹\,{x}_{1}=-6.
$$

Therefore, $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}-6 \\ 5 \\ -1\end{aligned}].$

Finally, 

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=(-6)+5+(-1)=-2.
$$
